narrative: A Mumbai Police constable, Pawan Sangle (driver rank posted at Sion police station), was caught on video threatening to plant drugs on student protesters during NEET paper leak protests. The video shows him saying 'I will put 50 grams powder in your bag' to intimidate protesters. The Mumbai Police suspended Sangle after the video went viral and an internal inquiry was ordered. Opposition parties called the footage extremely serious and demanded a time-bound judicial inquiry.
status_detail: Constable Pawan Sangle suspended. Internal inquiry ordered by Mumbai Police. Government ordered probe into video's authenticity and circumstances.
